name: Tomato and cucumber raita
intro: (or use your hands to better effect), scatter the chile and cilantro on top and

ingredients.item: small preserved lemons, seeds discarded, skin and flesh roughly chopped (¼ cup/50g)
garlic cloves, passed through a garlic press
cumin seeds, toasted and finely crushed
English cucumber (or 3 or 4 small Lebanese cucumbers), quartered lengthwise, seeded, and flesh cut into ½-inch/1cm dice (2 cups/300g)

method: Place all the ingredients for the chile paste in the bowl of a food processor, with ¼ tsp of salt. Blitz to form a rough paste and set aside.

Put the yogurt in a bowl and whisk with the mint, lemon juice, 1½ tsp of the cumin seeds, and rounded ¼ tsp salt. Add the cucumber, onion, and tomatoes and stir gently. Transfer to a shallow bowl and top with chile paste. Swirl lightly, sprinkle with the remaining ½ tsp of cumin seeds and serve.
